page.content:
Veteran exorcist called back from the Iraq dig.

How Father Lankester Merrin connects

  • Creator: Max von Sydow — Max von Sydow played Father Merrin.
  • Work: The Exorcist (1973) — Father Merrin arrives for the 1973 exorcism.
  • Faction: Jesuits — Merrin is the veteran Jesuit exorcist.
  • Character: Pazuzu — Merrin has faced this demon before Nineveh and Georgetown.
  • Event: The exorcism — Merrin leads the formal rite.
  • Location: Nineveh — Merrin's prologue confrontation happens at the Nineveh dig.

What is Father Lankester Merrin?

Father Merrin is the old priest who has met this demon before and arrives in Georgetown to begin the formal exorcism.

Key threads lead to Max von Sydow, The Exorcist (1973), Jesuits, Pazuzu, The exorcism and Nineveh.
